ROLES.TITLE: Discord Roles
ROLES.SELECT_ROLE_DESC: Click on a role in the list to view details and permissions.
ROLES.NO_MANAGE_ROLES_PERM: The bot does not have the ManageRoles permission. Roles can only be viewed, not edited.

ROLES.REASON_HIGHER: This role is higher than the bot's role and cannot be edited.

ROLES.HOIST_HELP: Members with this role will be displayed separately in the member list.

ROLES.DELETE_CONFIRM: Are you sure you want to delete this role? This action cannot be undone!
